summary: Retroactive sustainability offset applied to Dedicated invoice splits causing mid-cycle negative provisional balance
description: Issue summary: Customer GreenCart AI observed a small, unexpected retroactive charge labeled 'sustainability offset' applied to their mid-cycle Dedicated invoice. The charge was split across three cost centers and caused the organization's provisional balance to drop below zero and trigger an autopay hold alert. Impact: invoice shows -€3.42 sustainability offset distributed (incorrectly) across cost centers; customer-facing fiscal impact minimal but caused automated payment hold and confusion for finance. Environment: Dedicated contract (eu-west), reserved GPU pool, billing run timestamp: 2026-03-09T02:12:00Z. Timeline: 2026-03-09: nightly retrocharge job ran; 2026-03-10: GreenCart received provisional invoice and autopay hold; 2026-03-10 09:10 CET: customer opened support ticket. Request: please confirm why sustainability offset was applied retroactively, why it split across cost centers rather than the primary billing center, and request provisional hold reversal while we investigate.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer on Dedicated contract with multiple cost centers creates reserved capacity (eu-west).
2) Billing batch 'retrocharge-sustainability' runs as part of nightly adjustments (scheduled job ID: retro-20260309).
3) Billing service computes environmental surcharge offsets and emits adjustments to provisional invoice lines per cost center tags attached to postbacks.
4) Customer receives provisional invoice with offset lines and autopay hold triggers when provisional balance < 0.

investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: rate-mapper change (PR 4123) introduced behavior where sustainability offsets are distributed by present cost_center tags when primary_cost_center metadata is missing. GreenCart has a primary billing center set, but a recent onboarding change removed the primary tag on some reserved-capacity postbacks. SRE confirmed retrocharge job ran normally; billing-rate-mapper logged a fallback to per-postback tags. Reproducible in staging with the customer org's postback sample set. Potential fixes: ensure primary_cost_center is preferred, patch mapper to log and skip retrocharges when primary missing for dedicated customers, or reassign offsets to org primary cost center. Linking internal INT-3321 for a follow-up task to add a hard guard.

Billing Eng (Marco Ruiz) 2026-03-11 16:18: Applied a one-off provisional credit of €3.42 to return provisional balance to positive and cleared autopay hold. Patch queued: billing-rate-mapper v1.7.4 to prefer primary_cost_center when present. Scheduling hotfix deploy to prod on 2026-03-12 02:00 UTC.
resolution: Workaround applied: provisional credit of €3.42 issued 2026-03-11 to restore provisional balance and clear autopay hold. Root cause: billing-rate-mapper fallback path distributed sustainability offsets across cost_center tags when primary_cost_center metadata absent on some reserved-capacity postbacks. Fix: hotfix patch to billing-rate-mapper (PR 4123 rollback + targeted guard) scheduled and deployed 2026-03-12; post-deploy check confirmed future retrocharge runs used the org primary_cost_center. Follow-up: create a monitoring alert for retrocharge runs that touch >1 cost_center for dedicated customers (INT-3321). Customer notified and accepted provisional credit. Pending: audit entry and postmortem doc linked in Confluence.
